old_findings.note: BytesLib.slice's copy loop in parseVM did not change.

verifyVM's guardian-key storage copy still peels its first element ('mem[_21 + 160] = stor2[..][0]' before the while), and the signature loops are still 'while True'. parseVM's zero-init is no longer rotated (a P3 instance, not this finding).

regressions.old: mem[_103 + 32] = cd[vm + 324] / signer2 = ecrecover(mem[mem[64] len _103 - mem[64] + 160])
regressions.source: Messages.verifySignatures(vm.hash, vm.signatures, guardianSet): ecrecover(hash, sig.v, sig.r, sig.s)
regressions.issue: Inside the signature loop, vm.hash is now read as its memory copy mem[448] (set at 282 to cd[vm + 324]). The old text forwarded the calldata value. ecrecover's arguments are newly decoded, but the first one names the memory slot instead of the field.
regressions.rule: Carry the free-memory pointer's floor (above the decoded VM struct, here at least 480) into the loop, so stores at mem[64] + k cannot alias 448, and keep forwarding mem[448] = cd[vm + 324].

improvements: P6 is gone (12 lines). The 0x9ad79794 custom-error reverts are 'revert with 0x9ad79794' instead of raw memory. ecrecover's arguments are decoded in verifySignatures and verifyVM ('ecrecover(hash, uint8(_37), _35, _36)'), and the recovered signer is read as mem[_46 + 12 len 20] instead of 'mem[mem[64] - 20 len 20]'. verifyVM's return length simplifies to 'ceil32(_134) + 96'. parseVM's zero-init is a do-while, no longer rotated (P3).
notes: Diff 410 lines, read hunk by hunk. The verifyVM error paths (guardian set invalid/expired, no quorum) now build the (bool, string) return at explicit addresses. They were checked against the old ones: same words, same length. In the empty-guardian-set branch the base '_21 + 32 * stor2[..].length + 160' could fold to _21 + 160, since the length is 0 there.
summary: Improved: custom errors and ecrecover decoded, P6 and one P3 gone. One low regression: verifyVM's signature loop uses vm.hash's memory copy mem[448] where the old text forwarded cd[vm + 324].
